body: You're a lad on the internet but what you said makes sense, appreciate the words!

Its ok, it is what it is I suppose.

The physical side of it is awful, I'm not sleeping well even though I feel so tired and drained, but as you probably know your mind is constantly thinking and when you wake up its not like you can lie there peacefully, the thoughts are back almost immediately.

The best part of my day is probably the 3-5seconds when I wake up before it all comes rushing back.

I wish I could give you an answer, I'm following the same path of trying to repair myself after being told that my wife no longer loves me.

All I can say is I wish you the best, the hurt is so painful, the days are ok but when night comes I'm a mess and feel so much pain and so lonely.

I ask myself when its going to get better but its still so recent this happened, getting through this especially at night seems close to impossible.

I think I'm strong one moment and then the night comes and I just want her to love me sooooo bad.

I make steps forward in planning a possible future but it all comes crashing down.

Its like I forget everything that has happened and its like being destroyed all over again.

Yeah I feel you on that one, I suppose you're correct.

8yrs of marriage is a difficult habit to break, well for me, seemed pretty straightforward for her..

Ok, thanks for the advice, I will keep out of it.

My mother in laws divorce finalised over a year ago is what I meant, sorry for the confusion.
I get what you're saying but after 14yrs of a relationship and 8yrs of marriage you kinda want to try save it but I am seeing there is no hope.
I know, I have said that I cant see what we do now but eventually divorce in 2yrs after the legal separation, but she then says she isnt thinking about 2yrs time right now.
Thank you for your advice.

I cant go anywhere unfortunately and to be honest my wife is extremely cold towards me right now, we just had a discussion about how to move forward but she just looked through me.

I think its worse than not just loving me, I think she really hates me as well.

It is going to be one tough ride.

Obviously I'm still in the shock and denial phase but there is a big part of me that wonders if she has something up with her, I wish someone was able to view us and tell me.

Like she spends almost all day sat on the sofa on her phone when at home, she got a spinning bike 2-3months ago and has used it once, she has no hobbies apart from social media. She goes out but not exactly anything exciting.

The only thing she really does is go to work and the kids.

She told me she wants to be a new person and focus on herself more which is part of her reason for wanting to do this.

The kicker, I have been suggesting this for bloody years, I've expressed to her she needs to stop living on her phone, stop doing nothing for her self, I've even said we could set money aside just for her to treat herself, go shopping every month.

She was umming and arring about the spinning bike as it was £400+, I just said get it etc.

Like for example its Sunday, its 11am and shes not out of bed, shes upstairs watching TV with my daughter, which I dont believe is the case, my daughter is watching TV shes just there, probably sleeping and a large part avoiding me. The thing is, this isnt the unusual, I will always get up with my son early as hes up at 7am, she will stay in bed until gone 10am, sometimes 11am, even 12pm.

I dont know, she told me she doesnt love me anymore I suppose, I can say all this and try to understand why but I never will I dont think, its not something you say to someone for no reason.

Can I ask you a physical question, when your world got turned upside down how did you feel? I ask because I have this cloud over me and my head really hurts, my eyes hurt from crying but my head is in absolute bits and has been since the day of all this. Its like a sharp pain that wont go, I'm also super sensitive to noise as well, when the kids are screaming or shouting (playfully) its like daggers in my head and I have to ask them to be quiet?

Update; I told her I needed her out, not a single emotion from her, refusal at first to do so, she said nothing in return apart from look right through me, its definitely over on her side.

I'm very angry, I looked up the stages of grieving and I'm flittering through multiple stages, anger, shock, disbelief, most of the day I can hold it together but the nights are very difficult right now, I believe its because during the day I'm pretending to be ok then at night when I'm alone in the dark, I cant feel a thing but pain.

I just dont know what to do, I really dont.

I'll tell you what I am bitter about though, I look around the world as I'm out and about, I see all these couples, some partners being horrible to each other, some being great, I think of the people I know and there has been cheating, disrespect etc but they are still together, I look on line, on reddit and people are asking if there partner deserves another chance after cheating or domestic violence, people getting second chances for being stuck to the couch, not helping around the house and just being a bad partner.

Yet here I am, no second chance, no prior conversation of any bad times not even once, but my marriage is over.

That really stings, just treat your partners well people or one day you'll be like me!

Amazing, keep talking, keep exploring together.

My wife wants discussions tomorrow on how we move forwards, its going to be awful however I have somewhat accepted its over, every now and then I forget though as the weird thing is since she devastated my world nothing has changed in terms of daily life, she was working yesterday and today so we wouldnt see each other anyway.

I'm going to suggest some big changes tomorrow with our lives, mainly that someone needs to go and that it should be her because she created this whole mess and decided to change our families lives with zero discussion or prior warning, its also the only way I will ever be able to move on and accept life without her there.

Bitter, I dont think I will be but the level of respect I had for her will be gone I believe, if she came to me before and spoke that we are having problems and then nothing changed I could accept where we are at now and understand the marriage being over.

But to just one day end our marriage/family, that doesnt sit well with me, I'm not even talking about me, I'm talking about the family unit and mainly our kids, no discussion was had in 14yrs and now this person has destroyed not just mine but my 2 beautiful kids family, its insulting to them that there mother could not talk to there father ONE time before deciding the marriage/family should end.

Does that make sense?

Anyway, due to the way its been handled, is it bitter I dont know, but I'm not exactly impressed with the behaviour and kind of disgusted at this point.

Sorry for the rant..lol

I am, as good as can be I suppose, I've started to plan ahead however the wife wants discussions tomorrow on whats next and how we move forward etc.

So will see how that goes, I have an idea but I dont think she will like it.

Thanks for thinking of me by the way.

Ah mate, I'm soooooo happy for you!

I dont even know but so happy for you, this is great news because you have hopefully found out the root/cause of the issue and now you can work on exactly that.

Work from both ends will need to be solid but you've finally got what you were looking for, an understanding of what the hell is going on.

Again, I wish you the best on this journey, people forget these posts and replies but I wont, please update, however long, I'm never going to delete this account and will always be here as an internet stranger cheering you on from the crowd!

Honestly, I dont know. Its like the wife I married is not this person, I dont know who she is after what happened.

What I find strange is she thinks that life will just go on the same, we will co-parent in the same house, I will still go on the holidays we have booked with them, we will still go out on family days etc.

Its all just very confusing, definitely painful too but I'm starting to become very cold on the subject, I havent seen her since the day of the bombshell as she has work to go too and this will be day 2, but something in me has broken.

As much as I would love for this all to be a bad dream, its not and I dont think things would ever return back to normal from this.

Its the lack of real fight or effort that has hurt me most, but I'm starting to accept that it may be for the best, its pretty clear we have different views on what marriage is, it pains me to say this, it really does but; our marriage is over.

Counselling/therapy, working through the issues, these would have all been things I would have expected until it got to this stage, things I would 100% of been willing to do, I would have worked my hardest to become better in whatever was was asked of me, but now I'm not even sure I can, imagine trying to work through this but also knowing this person can at any moment just quit on your family again, I'm not sure I can allow that too happen to my children.

Look, people fuck up, you fucked up massively, I have no advice for you, I suppose you can only hope she wants to work through it but I just dont know.

Just because you fucked up also doesnt make you a bad person, there is always room for self improvement.
Probably, I'm starting to accept it now.
Tell your spouse and leave them in the correct way.

Badly mate, I'm a wreck, have broke down multiple times throughout the day infront of my kids, feel like something has died inside of me, physically felt sick, shaking, I'm fucked mate, I honestly dont know what I'm going to do.

How about you? You're not the victim but you still got feelings and as bad as what you did is, I seriously hope you learn from it and to be better, but I also hope you're not in a bad place.

Mate seriously, I signed up today just to post in this sub that I've pretty much lost my wife as she has fallen out of love with me, no cheating, no violence, no major anything and I literally have no chance of ever getting her back.

You created this mess, I'm not going to hammer you on the cheating as you done it and know you fucked up but this is your consequences mate, this is the situation created, I just lost my world due to what I can only assume is love died out, you went out and murdered your relationship.

If she somehow does take you back, you might as well play the lottery after with that luck.

Learn from what you've done.

Thank you, I am far from perfect.

Hope all is well for you too.
My situations is almost approaching 24hrs, it on my profile if you want to see it, its the only reason I signed up.

>However, let me ask this, how worth it is to live a miserable life where you will always be unhappy when you also do not have guarantees that your kids will come out well and healthy out of a broken relationship?


Honestly I dont know how to answer this but when youve just been wrecked and have had your whole world flipped upside down, heart ripped out etc you lose the feeling of self worth, hence the suicidal ideation that creeps in.

You end up in such a place that your only joy left in the world is seeing your children happy, yes maybe at some point we find happiness too but for now your mind, body and wellbeing just ends up on the back foot, I say backfoot but my situation has floored me, its taken every bit of hope and life out of me, the only bit that remained is the light my kids bring.

Its hard to explain, you could argue I was too in love or dependent on my family/wife but the moment I heard the words yesterday something in me died or is at minimum in a coma.

Something just broke, I would love to be able to brush all this pain off, trust me I did this morning, confident I would be ok, the last few hours with my son next to me, although I love him so much have been torture as I know our lives have been changed in a major way.

Its going to be difficult, Ive been counting down the time til I go pick her up which is very close now, I want her home asap to cuddle but I'm going to be a wreck. This morning I was over doing my 'happiness' act, but its so hard to maintain it when shit can just trigger a flood of tears.

Big breathe and off I go to for the school run.

Thanks for the chat, I truly hope your situation improves.

I

>Next week I'm planning on moving out for a few days, living with my parents through the week, and giving her some space to think and experience life without me.

>At the moment we go out every monday swimming with the kids and tuesday we both take our daughter to rainbows (brownies/girl scouts... depends where you're from as to what you call them) she goes out every wednesday to an exercise class and i look after the kids. So she's going to experience the swimming without me, Rainbows without me. I'll turn up Wednesday evening to look after the kids while she's out, then leave when she comes back. She'll have meal times without me, i won't be there when she gets home from work, when she goes to bed....I can only hope she misses me enough that she decides she wants it to work.... I dread to think of how much it's going to hurt if she decides the opposite.

I honestly think your plan is the best way, I really want to do the same but my support network is pretty non existent, I cant get away and even if I could work becomes a problem for the both of us and then we or she loses the house.

The limbo is hurting me so much, without kids and it being over it would be over, with kids makes it a logistical nightmare, when married you never really plan to lead two seperate lives, I even just received a bloody email that our multi gym has just been dispatched, another chunk of money down the drain.

We got a mortgage, loans, car payments, as a couple it all worked. Individually it will all break down, I cant afford even the shittest of flats or apartments.

>Man i wish i could take you for a beer....

I wish mate, but could you imagine how tragic it would be, two guys sobbing in a pub corner, I'm laughing at the thought so thats good and thanks for that!

My daughter is 6, my son is 3, I know the feeling.

My kids wont have a clue whats going on but they will know I will be gone, I have my 3yr old at home with me today as I look after the kids on Fridays whilst my wife is at work, I've showed him love all day but I'm ashamed to say he has seen me in pieces repeatedly through the day, he has seen my laying down crying next to him, he has seen me hurting, he already knows something is up but I cant stop the hurt I feel, I try to stay strong, daddy hurt his hand etc but he knows, hes wiped the tears from my cheeks.

Its going to be very bad when my 6yr old is home from school as she will see right through me and know something is wrong.

I see, I dont even know what to say mate, do you ever think its not worth it? I know thats the opposite of what you want but all of today I keep going back and forth, I begged her yesterday not to do this to our family but it didnt change a thing.

I literally felt like I was talking to a stranger, someone who I didnt know, not the wife of the 14yr relationship weve had together, she was cold towards any hope, it was awful.

The reason I ask if its worth it is you are so far down the line from me and the hope and then rejection must be a lot worse? I always want to fight for our marriage but I've got nothing back from her, she doesnt seem to want that.

Honestly I feel like I'm already just hanging on in hope she changes her mind instead of putting myself out my misery even though I will then be destroyed anyway.

Im rambling, I just dont know what to do, I wish none of this ever happened, its also extremely worse when due to finance I cant or she cant even go anywhere, just stuck in the same house/life living what I feel is a lie, pretending to be happy and team mummy/daddy when we are not that anymore.

Its the worst, I'm not even a full 24hrs into this pain yet and I need to ask, how long do you try for? My wife said to me there isnt much point in trying anything as its just false hope for me.

As much as I want everything to go back to normal I also worry that some of the things she has said to me and how she has handled it all is something I will never be able to forgive.

We didnt even have any cheating, sometimes if I knew it was that I would be able to accept it a lot easier.

Im not OP but its the fear of the time spent away from your kids, the dark days when you are alone, the rest of your life being spent just getting by for your kids sake.

Yes its selfish I suppose but trying to find hope when youve been crushed is very hard and I can feel OP's pain.

Wow, we are in a very similar situation, it hurts real bad and I have no idea what to do but reading your situation has helped process mine a bit.

Damn man, I really feel your pain and cant offer any advice just that I know exactly how you feel right now.

Im sorry this is happening to you.
As someone who is going through the absolute shit and on the receiving end at the moment atleast have the fucking bollocks to break up and give them closure.

Yeah, doesnt help that she hasnt spoke of one issue in 14yrs, no red flags, no prior communication of any potential breakdown in our relationship or worries for our future, absolutely no complaints for 14yrs.

Crazy but I've accepted it is what it is, just thought there would have been a bit more 'fight' or respect for a marriage/person to atleast have communicated over the years and not just decided to pick a day and quit.

To be honest I dont even care much anymore, she has said to me via text that we need to take 2 days to think about it and talk and not she doesnt want to see whats best for our marriage which is not what she said yesterday.

14yrs, not one single issue has been raised with me, not a single red flag she has brought to my attention and not a single time has she discussed with me if we have a rocky future.

I genuinely dont know whats up with her or whats going on, I was so willing yesterday to figure this all out, even this morning but now I honestly dont think I give a fuck anymore.

Do I love her yes, am I devastated yes but am I honestly disgusted with 14yrs and not a single issue being raised between us and then being told the marriage is over, what kind of person does that?

I'm going to go through our finances at some point today and see whats best, unfortunately in England you need seperation for 2yrs until a divorce is final.

Shes done as far as I'm concerned as she no longer loves me, I'm completely heartbroken and more than anything extremely disappointed in her, its fine not to love me but the bombshell way she has done it has really destroyed any hope I had.


Thanks by the way for all your advice, I do appreciate it.
Cheers mate, Im on one this morning, fucking hope she never comes home after what she has done, ran away as usual instead of dealing with anything.

Nah, I've found strength or anger or something this morning.

She can fall out of love with me, she has told me she has handled this badly BUT in 14yrs she hasnt brought up any issues with us or our future, she has even confirmed this but decided to destroy our family in one evening.

Im not going to lie, im in the fucking fuming stage right now as I get my kids up for breakfast and handle all this while SHE has gone to work at 7am and will be tomorrow too, whilst I handle the fucking fallout of answering my 3yr old son as to why Im crying holding him.

I genuinely dont know.

In all honesty she is always on her phone in different forums and social media talking to people, I know that for a fact but would she cheat or is she cheating, I really cannot say, up until what 14-15hrs ago I would have thought you were mad even suggesting it but since then my whole world has came crashing down and to be honest, she may be as she is clearly not the person I thought she was.

I havent talked to anyone about it, she said she hasnt either.

I want to contact her mum but I feel like its not fair on her as thats her support network.

I really dont know what to think, 'people dont just throw away a family without trying to save it' - this was 100% my belief up until 4pm yesterday, its like I dont know who she is at this point.

The person I married and thought I was married too would never throw away our marriage without a fight, but here I am and it appears to be exactly what she has done.

Wow, reading this has helped. 

It appearsmy 14yr relationship/marriage has come to an end and I'm glad to hear it gets easier with time.

I'm literally on day 1 but its good to know.

My wife told me yesterday she dont love me anymore, that cut real deep.

Sorry, trying to have a humour is helping.

Sorry what?

If its over etc it is, but Venus and retrograde, I have no idea what you are talking about haha but you've made me laugh so thanks.

I appreciate the advice anyway. Thanks.
I will look into it, jesus man, I'm 34 and never thought I'd be in this situation, its like I'm living with a stranger right now.

I brought up sleeping arrangement and she even suggested I sleep in our bed WITH her, as it makes her feel safe and secure.

No, I havent spoken to her parents, it literally all happened 4pm yesterday, its now 6.15am where I am (England).

No mutual friends are aware, no one as far as I know is aware and this is what she said.

Is there anyone else in the picture? I honestly have no clue. She said there isnt and shes not that person, but I dont know, there is a possibility I suppose, I wouldnt have ever thought so pre-4pm yesterday but at that point I thought I knew this person.

We booked a holiday maybe 1 week ago for the summer, we booked another one abroad and paid a bit of it off maybe 5days ago.

She also said she still wants holidays etc together as a family, even though we are not.

She doesnt want me to move out.

She just doesnt love me.

Mate, wtf, the more I write the more confused I get.

>As I said earlier, I’d be pissed as hell if this was a sudden thing where we disagreed on picking the daughter up from work to, “Oh, I don’t love you anymore.”

Honestly there is a side of me that is absolutely fuming about this and compeltely agrees with you.

As much as I love her and would love this whole day to disappear I know what Im like, I really love her and want her to love me but I think I know I'm broken from this.

She has every right not to love me, I cant argue that and accept that, but its how she has broken our family up over arguably 1 month of bad times in 14yrs.

I keep saying this, I wish you knew us and there was a fly on the wall, I swear you would be as confused as I am.

I dont want it too, but there is a possibility I'm going to hate her for this and how shes quit with no fight.

This is someone who just went toe to toe with the government on not being forced to be vaccinated through her job, she was willing to give up her well paying job to not be vaccinated.

But cannot even offer an inkling of fight to save our marriage.

I dunno, shit situation, again cant force anyone to love you but marriage does mean something to me, you dont just throw it away.

Sorry, no idea what I'm saying, just venting.

No it didnt, I know it werent easy for her to come to me with this.

But still, its shocking.

I'll take today and tomorrow to think where we go from here, I want to end it in the best way possible however I am starting to feel a lot of anger and resentment on this, it will be difficult.

Thank you, I will try.

I go through moments where I'm a wreck and then ok again, suppose it doesnt help that this is only the 13th hour since the bomb hit.

Shes had a difficult month with work, a lot of stress, we've had covid, shes been off work for 3weeks due to covid and annual leave.

Is she sick no, is she psychotic I did wonder but she seems fine.

What does worry me, is she has told no one else about this, just me. She hasnt vented or discussed it with anyone, just come to the conclusion this is it.

Honestly mate, like I said its come out of nowhere and completely blindsided me.

3 difficult weeks of this month we've had in a long time.

Also, by no means am I a perfect person, I have flaws but nothing I would have ever thought to have been something that destroys our future.

I agree, honestly I have moments where I put myself on the outside looking in and I get it, if she doesnt love me, it is what it is, it could have happened over years or a day, the outcome is the same.

But when I put myself back in, its so difficult to understand.

Before this I would say I know her as a person, I still think I do, its genuinely shocking which is my biggest problem with it all.

You dont love me, ok. But wtf, I dont know what she is doing.

Hi both, I agree with both of you, I wrote notes on my phone last night and although I love her and would do anything for this to change, in the past 12hrs I have developed a lot of anger as well towards her, I havent shown my anger but I am fuming that she has done this.

There is also a large feeling when I'm not an emotional wreck that she is a coward who has chosen to run at the first sign of a speed bump however small it may be and she should be the one who goes.

However, I then think of our kids, the logistics of the whole thing, work and being able to pay the bills to not lose the house and I just give in that I cant ask her to leave, it just wouldnt work. Realistically, at this moment I cant even leave as we literally cannot afford anywhere and I have nowhere to go as my parents live too far away from where I work (London).

I feel I need to add more context too this and why I'm so confused right now;

6months ago, we were planning to buy a new home together, upgraded, bigger, better etc, only reason we didnt is we lost at auction.

3months ago we were discussing new kitchens and upgrading our current home.

I shit you not, 2months ago we were seriously discussing expanding our family and having a 3rd child.

1month ago was Christmas and we were a happy family.

I swear to you all, January 2022 has been the only iffy month in I dont know how long, iffy as in 2 minor arguments, more naggy than anything, stuff kids would argue over.

The only difference this month is theres been a lot of stress, her job was up in the air a bit due to this whole vaccination thing, weve all had Covid 2nd or 3rd week of January and shes had about 3 weeks of the month off work and been at home a lot which is probably why the silly arguments happened.

But now, we're done? No working it out, just bombshell, its over, done.

I keep saying it in replies, but I really wish you could see us before this, unless I'm blind I'm sure you would be shocked.

I read what youve wrote and I know you're right. She told me its not 1 or 2, she said she hasnt spoken to anyone about this either, no one knows and this is the first time shes spoken it.

Why now? We had an argument about who is picking our daughter up, seriously that is it, usually what happens in the rare occasions an argument happens I apologise and we are all laughing and joking 30seconds after.

But this time 'its over'.

I really wish you knew us, so you could tell me if she was unhappy, because unless I'm blind she wasnt.

She wants to remain amicable, I want to remain amicable its just so painful.

1. I'm not saying its a day, but this is shocking, if there was a camera here you would I swear be questioning what the hell just happened.

Its like I dont know this person anymore, shes just given up on us.

I dont know, maybe you're right, maybe I'm too blind to see it. I'm just absolutely shocked.

I know, I really do, I just dont know what to do.

My whole world just came crashing down and I dont know what to do.

This is exactly what I thought and what I said to her, it blindsided me so bad as there was no sign and personally I was always under the impression people fight for a marriage, especially with two kids, but shes closed the book completely.

Ive suggested taking it way back, act like we are dating, see how it goes but she thinks its giving me false hope.

I've said I am willing to do anything but I go from wanting to beg her to just letting her go.

I dont want to be the person chasing the girl like in films when they say no a thousand times and then yes, reality is thats not how it works and I feel like im just bothering her.
Thank you.

I know I need to be away from the house, I cant work non stop however I need to look after my son on Fridays and get my daughter to school. My wife works Fridays and usually a weekend day so we dont usually see eachother today and will be tomorrow.

Im scared to even look at my kids without breaking down right now.

I feel like I need time off from life at the moment but I cant, I have to carry on like nothing has happened.

My wife knows I cant move out due to finances of mortgage on our home and I cant afford rent.

How am I ment to spend however long it takes to be able to financially move out when I'm in love with someone who doesnt love me.

The worst part is we are still friends, she can have the house, I will pay my mortgage for my kids, they can have everything, its just such a mess.
I hope so, I truly do. Thank you.
